qa_pairs.question: What is the page number for this antilock braking system diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 3450-1 of the Antilock Braking System (ABS) section.

qa_pairs.question: What are the four main solenoid valves shown in the ABS hydraulic unit?
qa_pairs.answer: The four main solenoid valves are: LH FRONT SOLENOID VALVE, RH FRONT SOLENOID VALVE, REAR SOLENOID VALVE, and PUMP MOTOR.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color designation is used for the connection from splice S242 on page 3450-9?
qa_pairs.answer: .75 RD/YL wire connects from splice S242 on page 3450-9.

qa_pairs.question: How many wheel speed detectors are shown in this ABS system diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Four wheel speed detectors are shown: LH FRONT SPEED DETECTOR, RH FRONT SPEED DETECTOR, LH REAR SPEED DETECTOR, and RH REAR SPEED DETECTOR.

qa_pairs.question: What are the wire gauge and color specifications for the connection to the LH FRONT VALVE CONTROL?
qa_pairs.answer: The LH FRONT VALVE CONTROL uses 1.5 BR/RD wire specification.

qa_pairs.question: What component connects to terminal 16 BR in the power distribution section?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery connects to terminal 16 BR in the power distribution section.

qa_pairs.question: What is the destination of the connection labeled '75 GY/RD' at terminal 7?
qa_pairs.answer: The 75 GY/RD wire at terminal 7 goes FROM S118 ON OTHER PAGE.
